tasks.title: Impact analysis on validation and config
Design denylist config and matching rules
Enforce denylist on every redirect (incl. cache)
Tests: matching rules, create and redirect

risks.risk: Suffix matching could block lookalikes or miss subdomains
risks.mitigation: Match exact domain or '.'+domain only; tests for both directions

risks.risk: Interpretation of a vague request may be wrong
risks.mitigation: Ambiguities listed with defaults and signed off before work starts

risks.risk: Blocking existing links breaks legitimate links on a bad entry
risks.mitigation: Removing the domain from config restores them; nothing is deleted
